index.title: Guess the stream time
index.subtitle: Real data from SullyGnome, over 20 years of Twitch history.
index.modeClassicDesc: A game is shown; guess how many hours it was streamed. The app tells you if it's higher or lower.
index.modeCompareDesc: Two games face off: pick the most streamed one and chain correct answers.
index.modeTopDesc: Find the most streamed games by typing their name. Three difficulty levels.
index.modeTimeDesc: A stream time is shown: find the game or games that match it.
index.dataHint: Data from SullyGnome, stored locally for 14 days.
index.extendedDataHint: Enable to include the top 200 games from the streamer instead of 50.

loading.title: Preparing the game
loading.note: The first download of a profile can take a few seconds (public CORS relay).

errors.title: Could not start the game
errors.notFound: No Twitch profile found for « {name} ». Check the spelling and try again.
errors.tooFew: Not enough distinct games for this mode (minimum: {min}).
errors.network: Could not reach SullyGnome. Check your connection and try again.

classic.question: How many hours was this game streamed?
classic.invalid: Enter a whole number of hours (0 or more).

compare.question: Which of these two games was streamed the most?

top.question: Find the most streamed games on this profile.
top.neverStreamed: This category has never been streamed.
top.notEnough: This category hasn't been streamed enough (Top {rank} / {hours} h)
top.wonDesc: You found every game in the top.

time.question: Which game was streamed for exactly this long?
time.wonDesc: You found every game streamed for exactly this many hours.

settings.title: Settings
settings.cacheDesc: Streamer profiles are stored in IndexedDB for 14 days to avoid re-downloading the same data.
settings.sourceDesc: All displayed statistics come from SullyGnome (aggregated Twitch data).
settings.proxyHint: To stop relying on public relays (allorigins), deploy the provided Worker in worker/ worker.js and paste its URL here. It receives ?url=<address>.
settings.useAlloriginsHint: Disable this if you use your own personal relay or if public relays are causing issues.
settings.publicRelaysDisabled: Public relays disabled — only your personal relay will be used
